title_en: Google AI Previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for Large Tool Libraries
title_zh: Google 在 Gemini API 中预览工具检索功能，支持大型工具库
summary_en: Google has launched Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API (preview in the Interactions API), allowing agents to defer loading tool parameter schemas until needed. By adding a tool_search entry and setting defer_loading: true, the model sees only tool names and short descriptions initially, then retrieves full schemas on demand. Server-side retrieval resolves search, schema load, and function call in one API request, while client-side mode supports custom registries at the cost of one extra round trip per search. There is no separate fee, but loaded schemas remain billed as input tokens for the rest of the conversation. Google published no token savings data, whereas Anthropic reports 85% savings and OpenAI 47% on their respective tests.
summary_zh: Google 在 Gemini API 中推出了工具检索功能（Interactions API 预览版），允许智能体延迟加载工具参数模式（schema）直到需要时。通过添加 tool_search 条目并设置 defer_loading: true，模型初始仅看到工具名称和简短描述，按需检索完整模式。服务器端检索在单个 API 请求中完成搜索、模式加载和函数调用，客户端模式支持自定义注册表但每次搜索增加一次额外往返。无单独费用，但已加载的模式在对话剩余部分仍按输入令牌计费。Google 未公布令牌节省数据，而 Anthropic 报告节省 85%，OpenAI 报告节省 47%。
content_en:
Google has launched Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, now in preview in the Interactions API. Gemini API Tool Retrieval lets an agent keep a large tool library available. It does not send every parameter schema in every prompt. The model loads a schema only when a task needs that tool. For agents wired to dozens of functions or MCP servers, it targets a real cost: tool definitions. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

## **TL;DR**

- **Tool:** An API feature with no stated tool cap. Google advises static loading under 20 stable tools.
- **Runs on:** Google’s servers (server-side search) or your own registry (client-side). Interactions API, `v1beta` only.
- **Performance:** Search, schema load and function call resolve in 1 API request in server mode.
- **Best:** 0 extra round trips and no index to host for server-side retrieval.

## **What is Gemini API Tool Retrieval?**

Tool Retrieval is a Gemini API feature that defers tool parameter schemas until the model asks for them. Google’s documentation states the problem plainly. A few dozen function declarations can consume tens of thousands of tokens on every request.

With deferral, the model sees only each tool’s name and a short description. It does not see the parameter schema until retrieval.

## **How does defer\_loading work in the Gemini Interactions API?**

You add `{"type": "tool_search"}` to the `tools` array. Then you set `defer_loading: true` on each function to hold back. The @googledevs launch post shows a deferred `issue_refund` function on `gemini-4-hydrogen`. Its code comment mentions 50+ other deferred functions.

**When the model needs a deferred tool, the response contains 3 steps:**

- `tool_search_call`: the model requests a tool by name.
- `tool_search_result`: the API returns the full schema.
- `function_call`: the model emits the call your code executes.

The API resolves the first 2 steps itself. Your app only runs the `function_call` and returns a `function_result`.

Deferred functions can carry an optional `short_description`. It is shown during retrieval and is valid only when `defer_loading` is true.

## **Server-side vs client-side retrieval**

Server-side is the default. Gemini runs the search, so there is no index to build or host.

Client-side mode uses `"execution": "client"`. Your app runs its own lookup, such as an embedding index, registry or permission filter. It returns matching declarations in `function_result.result`. Those tools can join mid-conversation, even if absent from the initial `tools` array. Each client-side search costs 1 extra round trip.

The 2 modes cannot be combined in 1 request. Only 1 `tool_search` entry is allowed per request.

## **Does it work with MCP servers and prefix caching?**

Yes on both, with caveats. Setting `defer_loading: true` on an `mcp_server` entry defers every tool that server exposes. Deferred MCP tools still execute remotely through the Gemini API MCP support.

On caching, deferred schemas stay out of the prompt prefix. Loaded schemas append inline, so implicit caching still applies. The docs add one catch: deferring tools can shrink a prompt below the minimum cacheable size.

## **What does Tool Retrieval cost?**

There is no separate fee. Tokens bill at the model’s standard input, cached and output rates. Each server-side search triggers an extra model call over the full context. Those tokens appear in `total_tool_use_tokens`, billed at the input rate.

Each loaded schema then stays billed as input for the rest of the conversation. The docs say static loading can cost less for small libraries or per-turn searches.

## **How does it compare with Claude and OpenAI tool search?**

Anthropic and OpenAI already ship similar tool search features, with published savings numbers.

| Feature | Gemini API Tool Retrieval | Anthropic Tool Search Tool | OpenAI tool search | 
|---|---|---|---|
| Status | Preview, `v1beta` | Not disclosed on docs page | Not disclosed on docs page | 
| API surface | Interactions API only | Messages API; Bedrock InvokeModel | Responses API | 
| Models | Gemini 4 Carbon, Neon, Hydrogen, Argon; 3.8 Flash; 3.6 Flash | Claude 5 series, Opus 4.5+, Sonnet 4.5+, Haiku 4.5 | `gpt-5.4` and later | 
| Search modes | Server or client | Regex, BM25 or custom | Hosted or client-executed | 
| Max deferred tools | Not disclosed | 10,000 | Not disclosed | 
| Results per search | Not disclosed | 5 by default | Not disclosed | 
| MCP deferral | Per `mcp_server` entry | Per `mcp_toolset` | On MCP server tool | 
| Separate fee | No | No | Not disclosed | 
| Published token savings | None | 85% (77K to 8.7K tokens) | 47% on 250 MCP Atlas tasks | 
| Published accuracy | None | Opus 4.5: 79.5% to 88.1% | Not disclosed | 

Anthropic and OpenAI figures are self-reported in their own tests. They are not comparable to any Gemini result.

## **Key Takeaways**

- Gemini API Tool Retrieval defers tool schemas until the model requests them.
- Server mode resolves search, load and call in 1 API request.
- Client mode supports custom registries, at 1 extra round trip per search.
- No extra fee, but loaded schemas stay billed and cannot be unloaded.
- Google published no savings data; Anthropic reports 85%, OpenAI 47%.

Check out the **Google blog post**, the **Tool Retrieval docs** and the **MCP function calling docs**. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

content_zh:
Google 已在 Gemini API 中推出工具检索（Tool Retrieval），目前已在 Interactions API 中提供预览版。Gemini API 工具检索让智能体可以维护一个大型工具库。它不会在每次提示中发送所有参数 schema。模型仅在任务需要某个工具时才加载该工具的 schema。对于接入了数十个函数或 MCP 服务器的智能体而言，它针对的是一项真实成本：工具定义。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome 扩展**查看部署选项和规格。

## **要点速览**

- **工具：** 一项未声明工具数量上限的 API 功能。Google 建议在稳定工具少于 20 个时使用静态加载。
- **运行位置：** Google 的服务器（服务端搜索）或你自己的注册表（客户端）。仅限 Interactions API 的 `v1beta`。
- **性能：** 在服务端模式下，搜索、schema 加载和函数调用在 1 次 API 请求内完成。
- **优势：** 服务端检索无需额外往返，也无需托管索引。

## **什么是 Gemini API 工具检索？**

工具检索是一项 Gemini API 功能，它会将工具参数 schema 推迟到模型请求时才提供。Google 的文档直白地说明了问题所在。几十个函数声明可能在每次请求时消耗数万个 token。

通过延迟加载，模型只能看到每个工具的名称和简短描述。在检索之前，它看不到参数 schema。

## **defer\_loading 在 Gemini Interactions API 中如何工作？**

你将 `{"type": "tool_search"}` 添加到 `tools` 数组中。然后对每个要延迟加载的函数设置 `defer_loading: true`。@googledevs 的发布帖子展示了 `gemini-4-hydrogen` 上一个延迟加载的 `issue_refund` 函数。其代码注释提到还有 50 多个其他延迟加载的函数。

**当模型需要某个延迟加载的工具时，响应包含 3 个步骤：**

- `tool_search_call`：模型按名称请求工具。
- `tool_search_result`：API 返回完整的 schema。
- `function_call`：模型发出由你的代码执行的调用。

API 自行解析前 2 个步骤。你的应用只运行 `function_call` 并返回 `function_result`。

延迟加载的函数可以携带一个可选的 `short_description`。它在检索期间显示，且仅在 `defer_loading` 为 true 时有效。

## **服务端检索与客户端检索**

服务端是默认模式。Gemini 运行搜索，因此无需构建或托管索引。

客户端模式使用 `"execution": "client"`。你的应用运行自己的查找，例如嵌入索引、注册表或权限过滤器。它在 `function_result.result` 中返回匹配的声明。这些工具可以在对话中途加入，即使它们不在初始 `tools` 数组中。每次客户端搜索需要 1 次额外往返。

这 2 种模式不能在 1 次请求中组合使用。每次请求只允许 1 个 `tool_search` 条目。

## **它能否与 MCP 服务器和前缀缓存配合使用？**

两者都可以，但有注意事项。在 `mcp_server` 条目上设置 `defer_loading: true` 会延迟加载该服务器暴露的所有工具。延迟加载的 MCP 工具仍通过 Gemini API 的 MCP 支持远程执行。

在缓存方面，延迟加载的 schema 不会进入提示前缀。已加载的 schema 会以内联方式追加，因此隐式缓存仍然适用。文档补充了一个注意事项：延迟加载工具可能使提示缩短至低于最小可缓存大小。

## **Tool Retrieval 的成本是多少？**

没有单独的费用。Token 按模型的标准输入、缓存和输出费率计费。每次服务端搜索都会针对完整上下文触发一次额外的模型调用。这些 token 会出现在 `total_tool_use_tokens` 中，按输入费率计费。

随后，每个已加载的 schema 在对话剩余部分都会作为输入持续计费。文档指出，对于小型工具库或每轮搜索的场景，静态加载可能成本更低。

## **与 Claude 和 OpenAI 的工具搜索相比如何？**

Anthropic 和 OpenAI 已经推出了类似的工具搜索功能，并公布了节省数据。

| 功能 | Gemini API Tool Retrieval | Anthropic Tool Search Tool | OpenAI tool search | 
|---|---|---|---|
| 状态 | 预览版，`v1beta` | 文档页面未披露 | 文档页面未披露 | 
| API 接口 | 仅 Interactions API | Messages API；Bedrock InvokeModel | Responses API | 
| 模型 | Gemini 4 Carbon、Neon、Hydrogen、Argon；3.8 Flash；3.6 Flash | Claude 5 系列、Opus 4.5+、Sonnet 4.5+、Haiku 4.5 | `gpt-5.4` 及更高版本 | 
| 搜索模式 | 服务端或客户端 | Regex、BM25 或自定义 | 托管或客户端执行 | 
| 最大延迟工具数 | 未披露 | 10,000 | 未披露 | 
| 每次搜索结果数 | 未披露 | 默认 5 | 未披露 | 
| MCP 延迟加载 | 按 `mcp_server` 条目 | 按 `mcp_toolset` | 按 MCP 服务器工具 | 
| 单独费用 | 无 | 无 | 未披露 | 
| 公布的 token 节省 | 无 | 85%（77K 降至 8.7K token） | 250 个 MCP Atlas 任务上节省 47% | 
| 公布的准确率 | 无 | Opus 4.5：79.5% 提升至 88.1% | 未披露 | 

Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的数据是各自在自家测试中自行报告的，无法与任何 Gemini 结果进行比较。

## **要点速览**

- Gemini API Tool Retrieval 会延迟工具 schema，直到模型请求时才加载。
- 服务端模式在 1 次 API 请求中完成搜索、加载和调用。
- 客户端模式支持自定义注册表，每次搜索额外增加 1 次往返。
- 无额外费用，但已加载的 schema 会持续计费且无法卸载。
- Google 未公布节省数据；Anthropic 报告节省 85%，OpenAI 报告节省 47%。
